name: UPSTREAM
note: EXTRACTED by tools/extract-examine.mjs from the documents its sources name -- errata 67's merge, in doc 05's, the batch's, then the repeats' order, less errata 68 H's drops. Do not edit: change the documents and re-run.

subjects.name: THE STAKES
LOOK_AT: Two sets of stakes on the same ground, crossing, each with a notice calling the other a liar.
One notice is in ink. The other is in larger ink.
I could settle this with a tape measure. Nobody here wants it settled. They want it won.
LISTEN_TO: A notice rattling on its stake.
Wind between the stakes, taking no side.

overrides.PULL: Pull one and I'm on somebody's side. Pull both and I'm on everybody's list.

subjects.name: THE BEST GROUND
LOOK_AT: The head of the gulch: the richest ground in the camp, and the most argued over.
Gold shows in the gravel here without digging. Nobody's digging. They're both guarding it.
In Consolation this would get a parade. Here it gets a man with a shovel and a grudge.
LISTEN_TO: Grit settling, then the river again.
Quiet ground. The only quiet thing up here.

overrides.PICK_UP: Gold, lying there. I reached. A shovel came down between my hand and it, gently.

subjects.name: THE SLUICE
LOOK_AT: A sluice, half built, abandoned when the argument started.
Somebody's nailed a board across it: NOT YET.
It would make them both richer. Neither will finish it while the other might gain.
LISTEN_TO: Water dribbling through a gap in the boards.
A loose plank knocking, in no hurry.
Water going round the sluice instead of through it.

overrides.USE: I'd finish it for them. NOT YET, says the board. I don't know whose 'yet' it is.

subjects.name: THE FALLS
LOOK_AT: A little waterfall where the gulch ends, no taller than a man.
Behind it, rock. Above it, more rock. This is as far as the gold goes.
The man upstream says his claim runs 'to the falls'. The falls haven't agreed to anything.
LISTEN_TO: Water on rock, the same note over and over. A low D.
The D again. Somebody should tell it there are other notes.

overrides.TALK_TO: I sang it an E, to give it ideas. It stayed on D.

subjects.name: DOWNSTREAM
LOOK_AT: Back down the river to the bar and the panners.
Downstream, where the gold is merely good.
From up here the panners look small and busy, like men in a painting of a gold rush.
LISTEN_TO: The river going away from here, glad to.
Somebody downstream shouting 'MINE!' again. It's the camp's favorite word.

THE MAN UPSTREAM.PICK_UP: If I lift him off that gravel, the other man wins it. I'd never hear the end of it from either.
THE MAN UPSTREAM.PUSH: One step his way and the shovel came up, flat, like a door shutting. I'm on the right side of it.
THE MAN UPSTREAM.USE: Use him for what? He does one thing, standing on gravel, and he does it without me.
